memory_update.text: The purest ABF substrate suppliers identified in the node context are mostly non-U.S.-listed Asian companies; U.S.-listed exposure is mainly second-order through advanced PCB, packaging equipment, inspection/metrology, laser drilling, and OSAT-related tools.

ASYS is the smallest U.S.-listed candidate found in this pass with explicit company language around AI semiconductor packaging and advanced wafer substrate fabrication; it should remain in Layer 1 as a hypothesis pending customer/order verification.

node: ABF substrates and advanced PCB/interconnect for AI accelerators, CPUs, GPUs, and advanced packages
summary: Layer 1B expanded the U.S.-listed universe around the ABF substrate / advanced interconnect bottleneck. The pure-play ABF substrate leaders are mostly non-U.S.-listed Asian suppliers such as Ibiden, Unimicron, Kinsus, and Nan Ya PCB, so the U.S.-listed discovery lane is mainly second-order: advanced PCB suppliers, substrate/advanced-packaging equipment vendors, metrology/inspection tools, and thermal/reflow equipment used in AI GPU packaging and advanced substrate fabrication. The most relevant U.S.-listed names found in this pass are not direct ABF film suppliers; they are plausible chokepoint-adjacent beneficiaries whose exposure must be verified through customer mix, AI/HPC revenue mix, order backlog, and whether their tools are specifically used in ABF/package-substrate capacity additions.
